patches_added.name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)
patches_added.description: Applies the Galaxy XR conversion foundation to the exact supported Steam Link builds through 2.0.22 build 5002244. Diagnostic force gates and controller tuning remain optional.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)
patches_added.description: Applies the existing native-Android-XR-safe Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)
patches_added.description: Applies the validated permission-free Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322, including the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_removed.name: Experimental Galaxy XR surface warm-up/omit performance A/B
patches_removed.description: Diagnostic-only exact 2.0.22/5002322 variant. It creates and queues the same 2x2 Android Surface, submits the fourth terminal quad for 7200 accepted frames, then retains every Surface resource while returning to Valve's original 3 projection layers. Use it only to determine whether the recurring fourth layer causes the extra compositor cost.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.

patches_modified.name: GXR face bridge
patches_modified.description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.

patches_modified.name: Microphone input preset
patches_modified.description: Selects the Android AAudio microphone processing mode used by Steam Link. Galaxy XR testing found Voice Recognition clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

patches_modified.name: Unrestricted battery usage
patches_modified.description: Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.

patches_modified.name: Video dither
patches_modified.description: Enables or disables VRLink video dithering, including the highp sRGB8 fallback and experimental RGB10_A2 shader variants.

patches_modified.name: Visual Delay Fix
patches_modified.description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths. Its trampoline uses a dedicated executable mapping over non-runtime ELF comment bytes and preserves live PLT entries.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Google Sign-In
patches_modified.description: Bypasses SHA-1 check by using embedded WebView OAuth for Google Sign-In.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables Firebase Crashlytics, Sessions, and Analytics.

patches_added.name: Patch native libraries
patches_added.description: Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle.

patches_added.description: Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle.
